IncidentBot: Pager triggered · Service= inference-runtime-prod · Severity=P1 · Symptom=5xx spike >10% on /v1/generate · Region=us-west-2 · Incident console: https://incidents.redwood.ai/3901122334

Jules (oncall): ACK. I'm awake and joining. Opening a live room (short huddle) — https://zoom.us/j/4512345678?pwd=xxxx · cc @Priya (SRE)/Marcus (ENG)

Priya (SRE): Confirmed pager to rotation. phone vibed, got alert. I'll grab infra checklist and confirm node health.

Marcus (ENG): I'm available. I'll take ownership for model-serving stack (allocating owner). Marcus (ENG) -> incident owner for this thread.

Jules (oncall): Roger. Owner set: Marcus. Priya, can you confirm we have a fallback routing policy enabled? If not, hold traffic to canaries.

Priya (SRE): Checking now. Prefix/KV caching looks healthy. Route policy: default routing still active. I'll temporarily pin traffic away from us-west-2 to us-east-1 for non-committed tenants — applying policy now.

ops-bot: Action: routing-policy-update request submitted by Priya (SRE) · Request ID=rp-20260315-001 · status=queued

Marcus (ENG): Looking at kube metrics: several inference pods in us-west-2 are crashing OOM when sequence length spikes. Logs: https://logs.redwood.ai/q/abc123. Running `kubectl describe pod inference-xx` shows rapid restarts.

Jules (oncall): Immediate mitigation options? temp scale, throttle, or revert recent config?

Marcus (ENG): Quick mitigation I'm going to apply: reduce max_concurrency on runtime config and enable token-level rate limit for public endpoints. Patch command (will run):

```sh
kubectl patch configmap inference-config -n prod --type merge -p '{"data":{"max_concurrency":"8"}}'
```

Marcus (ENG): Also preparing small rolling restart of affected deployment (graceful) to flush bad state. Not a full rollback yet.

Priya (SRE): I've started a temporary traffic shift for low-priority tenants. Will monitor 5xx rate in the next 2 mins.

Jules (oncall): Drafting status page update — please review and sign off before I publish. Minimal, factual, no speculation:

"We're investigating elevated error rates (5xx) impacting text generation endpoints in the us-west-2 region. Some requests may fail or experience increased latency. Our engineers are diagnosing and applying mitigations.

No evidence of customer data loss at this time. We'll post updates every 15 minutes or when there is a material change."

Marcus (ENG): LGTM with one edit: add that we've applied a temporary routing policy and are throttling concurrency for stability.

Jules (oncall): Updated. Final: "We're investigating elevated 5xx error rates affecting text generation endpoints in us-west-2. We have applied a temporary routing policy and reduced concurrency to mitigate impact. Some requests may still fail or see increased latency. No evidence of customer data loss. We'll provide updates every 15 minutes."

Priya (SRE): I'll prepare targeted customer notices for any customers with active Dedicated deployments in us-west-2. Template below — Marcus, adapt if you want different wording for SLO customers.

---begin template---
Subject: Incident affecting text-generation in us-west-2 (active investigation)

Hi {{customer_name}},

We're currently investigating elevated error rates for text-generation requests in us-west-2. Our site reliability and engineering teams are actively responding. You may see failed requests or increased latency; we do not currently believe there is any data loss.

If you rely on a Dedicated cluster in us-west-2 and are seeing degradation, please reply to this thread and we'll prioritize. We'll follow up with a mitigation ETA or next update within 15 minutes.

Thanks,
Redwood Inference SRE
---end template---

Marcus (ENG): That template works. For the enterprise customers, we'll add an optional line about escalation path to the dedicated account manager.

Jules (oncall): Ops checklist quick items:
- Confirm pager delivered to rotation (Priya)
- Owner assigned and running mitigations (Marcus)
- Post status page update (Jules)
- Notify Dedicated customers (Priya + support)
- Prepare RCA channel and evidence capture (logs, traces, runbook)

Priya (SRE): Pager confirmed. Mitigations in flight. I'll keep watch on error rate dashboards: https://monitoring.redwood.ai/d/err/5xx-rate

ops-bot: Event: routing-policy-update rp-20260315-001 moved to in-progress · executed by Priya (SRE)

Marcus (ENG): Patch applied and rolling restart initiated. Early signal: 5xx rate dipping from 12% -> 7% in last 90s. Still watching.

Jules (oncall): I'll post the status page now. Also creating an internal comms note for legal and trust teams. If anyone needs to escalate to SRE Lead, ping them directly: SRE Lead.

SRE Lead: pinged for visibility. Please advise if you want an immediate customer-wide notification rather than targeted notices.

SRE Lead: Received. Keep current cadence and surface any regression to >10% or data-loss indicators. Good job initial responders.

Marcus (ENG): Continuing to monitor. If we see reappearance after routing, we may revert last config change from earlier today. Will update here.

Jules (oncall): Handshake: Marcus remains owner. Priya remains primary SRE contact. I'll stay until we reach steady-state or hand off at next rotation.

Priya (SRE): Acknowledged. Moving to ongoing monitoring.

IncidentBot: Scheduled update reminder in 15 minutes.
